subjects.description: Malformed vehicles with subtly warped bodywork, inconsistent model-specific design, fused components, and implausible mechanical geometry.
subjects.appearance_details: Uneven headlights and taillights, distorted grilles, handles merging into door surfaces, discontinuous panel seams, misshapen windows, irregular wheel ellipses, fused wheel spokes, rubber merging into rims, and reflections resembling painted patches.
subjects.relationship: Vehicles intersecting neighboring cars or barriers, components merging across occlusion boundaries, tires floating above or sinking into the road, and missing tire contact shadows.
subjects.location: Geometry defects in foreground vehicles and unresolved, fused vehicle silhouettes in distant parking areas.
subjects.relative_size: Inconsistent wheel-to-body proportions and vehicle scale incompatible with scene depth.
subjects.orientation: Wheel ellipses, axles, body panels, and window frames following incompatible perspective directions.
subjects.pose: Broken chassis alignment, disconnected wheels, and bodywork deformed around partially hidden components.

subjects.description: Poorly reconstructed people with distorted anatomy, unrealistic body proportions, duplicated body parts, and an artificial mannequin-like appearance.
subjects.appearance_details: Extra or missing limbs, fused fingers, malformed hands and feet, disconnected joints, stretched torsos, and body contours melting into clothing or neighboring objects.
subjects.relationship: People merging into each other, hands passing through objects or failing to make plausible contact, limbs intersecting vehicle doors or windows, feet floating above or sinking into the ground, and incoherent body reconstruction behind occluding surfaces.
subjects.location: Anatomical reconstruction defects on visible people at any scene depth, including occupants seen through glass and partially visible foreground arms or hands.
subjects.relative_size: Heads, hands, feet, and limbs disproportionate to the body; human scale incompatible with nearby vehicles and scene perspective.
subjects.orientation: Impossible head rotation, twisted wrists and ankles, and inconsistent alignment between the head, torso, and limbs.
subjects.pose: Stiff mannequin-like posture, impossible joint bends, broken weight distribution, and unnatural hand gestures with fused or disconnected fingers.
subjects.clothing: Painted-on fabric, melted seams, clothing fused into skin, repeated fabric textures, folds inconsistent with body posture or material weight, and accessories merging into the body.
subjects.expression: Frozen mannequin-like expressions, mechanically exaggerated smiles, and distorted facial muscle structure.
subjects.skin_tone_and_texture: Waxy or plastic-looking skin, excessive smoothing, blotchy color transitions unrelated to illumination, smeared pores, and abrupt texture changes between adjacent body parts.
subjects.facial_features: Structurally misaligned eyes, duplicated pupils, fused eyelids, malformed ears, distorted noses, melted lips, teeth merging into an indistinct mass, hair merging into skin, and inconsistent facial detail across regions at the same viewing distance.

subject_details.vehicle_geometry: Distorted vehicle silhouettes, mismatched lamp assemblies, detached trim, discontinuous door seams, and mechanically inconsistent wheels.
subject_details.road_signs_and_signals: Deformed sign outlines, malformed pictograms, distorted signal housings, fused lamp lenses, disconnected poles, and hardware lacking a coherent mounting structure.
subject_details.reflections_and_glass: Mirror images with perspective incompatible with the reflecting surface, duplicated scene fragments, disconnected reflected vehicle contours, opaque glass patches, and reflections crossing window or mirror borders.
subject_details.fine_structures: Fence bars, railings, overhead wires, and panel edges that split, fuse, terminate abruptly, or change thickness without a structural cause.
subject_details.visible_anatomy: Malformed visible fingers, fused fingertips, twisted wrists, and limbs merging into nearby vehicle surfaces; incoherent animal limb contours where animals are present.
subject_details.human_anatomy: Duplicated or missing limbs, fused fingers, malformed hands and feet, impossible joint articulation, disproportionate body parts, and limbs detached without a coherent occlusion boundary.
subject_details.human_faces_and_skin: Uncanny mannequin-like faces, malformed eyes or teeth, waxy skin, excessive smoothing, smeared facial detail, and skin shading inconsistent with scene illumination.
subject_details.human_scene_integration: Bodies merging with vehicles or neighboring people, physically incoherent hand-object contact, detached contact shadows, and repeated identical faces or silhouettes across different people.

background_setting: Architectural edges melting into adjacent surfaces, inconsistent window and balcony geometry, disconnected railings, wires with broken attachment points, repetitive vegetation blobs, and distant parked cars reduced to fused silhouettes. Paving grids and curb edges bending independently of ground perspective, artificial texture tiling, and cracks turning into repetitive decorative patterns.

lighting.conditions: Artificially flattened surface shading, clipped highlights that erase material detail, and excessively crushed shadows that obscure vehicle components.
lighting.direction: Incompatible illumination and reflection directions across neighboring surfaces.
lighting.shadows: Missing or detached contact shadows, shadows crossing surfaces with incompatible geometry, and shadow edges disconnected from their casting objects.
lighting.illumination_effect: Plastic-looking car paint, exaggerated highlight halos, implausible glass reflections, and local brightness inconsistent with surrounding illumination.

aesthetics.composition: Broken depth ordering, fused silhouettes where objects overlap, and accidental tangencies caused by malformed object boundaries.
aesthetics.color_scheme: Color bleeding between adjacent materials, unnaturally uniform paint or foliage colors, posterized gradients, and excessive local saturation.
aesthetics.mood_atmosphere: Synthetic, overprocessed photographic appearance with inconsistent material realism.
aesthetics.patterns: Artificially repetitive paving, cloned foliage clusters, moire on fine grids, jagged fence bars, and sharpening halos along high-contrast edges.

cinematography.framing: Spatial discontinuities across windshield, dashboard, mirror, and scene boundaries; malformed contours at natural occlusions.
cinematography.camera_angle: Incompatible vanishing points between vehicles, buildings, signs, and the road plane; local perspective warping of rigid objects.
cinematography.focus: Selective loss of detail on subjects lying in the focal plane, smeared rather than optically blurred fine structures, abrupt cutout-like transitions between sharp and soft regions, and motion smearing inconsistent with object motion.
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Inconsistent perspective magnification and localized stretching of rigid geometry unrelated to a coherent lens projection.

style_medium: Artificial-looking photographic synthesis with painterly patches, plastic surfaces, and incoherently reconstructed fine detail.
artistic_style: Overprocessed photorealism, excessive edge enhancement, oversmoothed materials, and inconsistent realism between foreground and background.
context: Spatial, anatomical, and material reconstruction defects in generated still photographs of streets, parked vehicles, intersections, and roadside environments.

comprehensive_t2i_caption: A synthetic-looking street photograph with distorted vehicle geometry, melted panel seams, inconsistent headlight shapes, warped wheel ellipses, incoherent wheel spokes, and fused distant car silhouettes. Fine railings and wires split or merge, paving textures contain artificial repetition or violate ground perspective, and vegetation collapses into cloned or smeared texture clusters. Glass and mirrors contain geometrically incoherent reflections, overlapping objects have broken depth ordering, and tires have defective ground contact. Plastic-looking paint, overprocessed local contrast, sharpening halos, color bleeding, and selective smearing destroy fine detail in otherwise focused regions. Anatomical reconstruction artifacts affect visible hands or animals where present. Visible people have unrealistic body proportions, extra or missing limbs, fused fingers, malformed hands and feet, twisted joints, and stiff mannequin-like poses. Faces contain misaligned eyes, duplicated pupils, malformed teeth, melted lips, and incoherent hair boundaries. Skin appears waxy or excessively smoothed, clothing looks painted on or merges into the body, and human silhouettes have defective occlusion, ground contact, or interaction with nearby objects.
